source: Fischer FC, Ludtke S, Thackray C, Pickard HM, Haque F, Dassuncao C, Endo S, Schaider L, Sunderland EM (2024) Environ Sci Technol 58:1055-1063
what_it_supplies: HSA-water AND globulin-water distribution coefficients for PFAS with 4-13 perfluorinated carbons by C18 SPME. f_unbound in human serum 0.01-1.2%: PFOA 0.061%, PFHxS 0.041%, PFOS 0.042%, PFHpS 0.035%. Predicts f_unbound from an individual's albumin and globulin concentrations, R2 = 0.99 against measured serum distribution.

source: Smeltz M, Wambaugh JF, Wetmore BA (2023) Chem Res Toxicol 36:870-881
what_it_supplies: 67 PFAS human plasma f_up by ultracentrifugation with LC-MS/MS and Bayesian uncertainty bounds, from the US EPA Center for Computational Toxicology. Reports RED failure for PFAS of high mass or logKow > 4 through failure to reach equilibrium.

source: Qin W, Escher BI, Huchthausen J, Fu Q, Henneberger L (2024) Environ Sci Technol 58:9954-9966
what_it_supplies: Binding of anionic PFAS to BSA and human plasma is HIGHLY CONCENTRATION-DEPENDENT. Specific binding dominates at a PFAS:protein molar ratio below 0.1; physiological is below 0.01; in vitro assays often dose in excess above 1, where nonspecific binding dominates.

source: Prasad B, Johnson K, Billington S, Lee C, Chung GW, Brown CDA, Kelly EJ, Himmelfarb J, Unadkat JD (2016) Drug Metab Dispos 44:1920-1924
what_it_supplies: OAT4 at 0.5 +/- 0.2 pmol/mg total membrane protein in human kidney cortex, n = 41, by quantitative targeted proteomics, alongside OAT1 5.3, OAT2 0.9, OAT3 3.5. INDEPENDENTLY IDENTICAL to Thakur 2024's 0.5 +/- 0.2 from n = 15. The in vivo denominator of the REF exists and is replicated; the in vitro numerator still does not.

Tan 2024 remains the only demonstration of albumin-mediated uptake at OAT1/OAT3 and it used drugs. Fischer 2024 proposes the experiment in its closing paragraph, naming renal tubular reabsorption, so it is recognised as open by others too.

source: Butenhoff JL, Kennedy GL, Hinderliter PM, Lieder PH, Jung R, Hansen KJ, Gorman GS, Noker PE, Thomford PJ (2004) Toxicol Sci 82:394-406
what_it_supplies: Cynomolgus PFOA, six-month oral dosing at 3/10/20 mg/kg plus a 10 mg/kg IV arm, with SERUM, URINE AND FAECES measured at steady state and a terminal half-life of 14-42 days. Urine is the primary route. So the monkey has the clearance AND the mass balance; it has no plasma protein binding measurement, and searches for one return nothing in any species of macaque.
